title: EISCO Powder Funnel, 6" (150mm) Diameter - Polypropylene Plastic - Parallel Stem - Resistant to Acids & Alkalis - Great for Laboratory, Classroom or Home Use
description:
About this item
NO-SPILL TRANSFER || Useful for transferring powdered or liquid reagents
INDUSTRIAL QUALITY || Made of heat tolerant and chemical resistant polypropylene plastic
PARALLEL STEM || Parallel stem minimizes bridging of powder
GREAT FOR PROFESSIONAL LABORATORIES, CLASSROOMS & HOUSEHOLD || Designed for use in professional laboratories, but is an ideal choice for science classrooms, households, workshops & garages
DIMENSIONS || Top diameter 150mm (6 inches), total length 135mm (5.3 inches), stem length 31mm (1.2 inches), stem outer diameter 27mm (1.1 inches)
reviews_5s: Quality product and straight segment was useful to me and is not present in most funnels that seem to have a taper. Good quality and perfect size.I use this funnel for filling fuel tank on lawn mower and lawn tractor. Large discharge port allows fuel to flow easily without splashing. First funnel worked so well that I bought a 2nd to have as a spare.👍🏽Used to make large Valentines Day KissesThe price seems high, but funnel is solid.
